capture.zh: 在斯诺星岩洞挑战魔狮迪露（50级，总体力300万）；打败获得魔狮迪露精元（孵化得露露）。

strategy_notes.zh: 靠叠加异常的百分比伤害：先上布布花/依卡莱恩寄生种子，再上冻伤（阿克希亚/依依）、烧伤（里奥斯）、中毒（毒粉），在它跌破一半体力之前叠满；或阿克希亚极度冰点、魔焰猩猩绝命火焰直接秒杀。

engine_notes: HP 3,000,000 in ONE battle (not a server-wide pool): every source frames it as a single fight beaten by stacking percentage damage — 寄生/冻伤/烧伤/中毒 each take 1/8 max HP (375,000) per turn, so 3-4 stacked statuses kill it in 2-3 turns. No source describes HP carrying over between battles, so no chain/carry_hp is used (correcting the foundation 7.2 guess).
ignore_type_chart: 不受任何系精灵克制 — every hit on it uses multiplier 1.

ohko_attacks below 50% (体力少于150万: 秒杀任何精灵，无视任何副作用、无视速度、无视等级) — it acts first and every attack KOs. Later summaries (4399 2010-06-01, weste 2010-09, 7k7k 2011) give the threshold as 1/4; 50% is from the detailed 4399/7k7k boss pages.
block_new_status strictly below 1,000,000 HP (他血低于100万时异常效果无效): use the absolute HP threshold, not a rounded percentage. New statuses fail; statuses already on it keep ticking.
damage_scales_with_hp_lost: 体力越少攻击越强 (no formula given).
Not immune to ohko ops: 极度冰点 and 绝命火焰 were standard answers.
Status damage here follows RULES 7: poison/burn/freeze/leech each take 1/8 max HP per turn (percent damage), and several DoT statuses can be on the boss at once (classic 叠加异常).
reward: 精元 item (kind essence) hatching the base form of the line at Lv1, as the original 分子转化器 did (e.g. 里奥斯精元 → 胡里亚, 阿克希亚精元 → 索拉, 斯普林特精元 → 斯林德).
source_note: 4399 & 7k7k (2010-05/06): 50级 总体力300万, 不受任何系克制, 150万以下秒杀, 100万以下异常无效, 不免疫冻伤/烧伤/中毒/寄生.
